IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Tuesday 3 November
Winds: South to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots becoming variable below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Southwesterly 10 to 15 knots shifting north to northwesterly below 10 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 6 November
Winds: Northwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending westerly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then decreasing to about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Saturday 7 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the morning then decreasing to 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A weak ridge sits over Tasmania today. A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west tomorrow, with a ridge developing from a high over the mainland on Thursday. A more significant cold front is forecast to move over from the west during the day on Friday, followed by a cold southwesterly wind flow on Saturday.
